actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item Bite]] attack and two [[/item Tentacle]] attacks.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition. Whenever the Poisoned target finishes a Long Rest, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.formula activity=tKShuY4vDM7tn9aC]]. Failure: The target's Hit Point maximum decreases by [[/damage 1d10 average]] and doesn't return to normal until the Poisoned condition ends on the target. Success: The Poisoned condition ends.

actions.name: tentacle
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]) from one of two tentacles.

actions.name: tentacle slam
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=VC2iSwNPNaZ7M2bT]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=VC2iSwNPNaZ7M2bT]] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: Half damage only.
